mcq_choices.rationale: A good fit would show unstructured residual scatter.
A structured residual pattern shows that the model has not captured part of the relationship.
Residual plots can be used for quantitative responses.

parts.prompt:
A residual plot for an exponential regression shows a clear U-shaped pattern. This most strongly indicates

A. the data are exactly exponential
B. the model systematically misses curvature
C. all residuals are zero
D. the response variable is categorical

required_evidence: A structured residual pattern shows that the model has not captured part of the relationship.
